title: The Caravan Road
summary: Raiders hit Marta's caravan on the road. Drive them off, then break the band that sent them.
ask: Marta: You. With the face. Can you fight? Say yes.
Marta: Raiders came out of the scrub. They'll be back for the wagons before dark.

start: Marta: Here they come. Mind the mules.
done: Marta: Ha! Look at them run. And they'll run straight home, too.
A cold fire and a stolen crate of Guild salt. Their leader can't be far.

start: A big one stands up from behind the crates, with an axe and an opinion.
done: The rest of the band scatters into the scrub and doesn't look back.
Marta: You did what? Alone? Remind me never to owe you money.
Marta: Here. A Guild writ with my mark on it. Any Guild stall will treat you like family. Better than family.
